title.ja: ローン前払い手数料詐欺（loan fee fraud）

short_desc.ja: 融資の前に『手数料』『保険料』名目で前払いを要求し融資は実行されない
short_desc.en: Demands upfront 'fees' for loans never delivered.

cultural_lever.ja: 生活困窮・急な資金需要・信用情報への不安

scenario.ja: 1) オンラインで融資申請した相手に接触 2) 25〜450ポンドの前払い手数料要求 3) 迅速送金・ギフトカード・暗号資産での支払い要求 4) 融資は実行されない
scenario.en: 1) Target online loan applicants 2) Demand £25–£450 upfront fee 3) Pressure to pay via wire, voucher, or crypto 4) No loan delivered

ja: Google Play・Amazon・Ebay などのギフトカード支払い
en: Payment via gift cards (Google Play, Amazon, eBay)

ja: 融資は FCA 認可業者のみに限定
FCA Firm Checker で業者を確認
MoneyHelper で無料の債務相談
en: Verify firms on the FCA Firm Checker
Seek free debt advice via MoneyHelper

legal_notes.ja: FCA 0800 111 6768 へ報告。被害平均は £255 と FCA が公表
legal_notes.en: Report to FCA 0800 111 6768; average loss £255 per FCA

references.label: FCA: Loan fee fraud
references.quote: Scammers will often try to target individuals who’ve applied for loans online. They may contact you unexpectedly and will offer you the money you need. But before giving you the loan, they’ll ask for an upfront payment as a deposit, administrative fee or insurance. ... Or they may ask you to buy a voucher, for example from Google Play, Amazon or Ebay.

verification.note: FCA が接触経路（contact unexpectedly）と要求（upfront payment）、支払手段（voucher from Google Play, Amazon or Ebay）を具体的に記述。被害平均は £255 と FCA が記しているため risk_score=3
